metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Daredevil: Born Again
metas.description: Matt Murdock finds himself on a collision course with Wilson Fisk when their past identities begin to emerge.

metas.name: ★ 4.5 · 2025 · Ironheart
metas.description: Genius teenage inventor Riri Williams creates the most advanced suit of armor since Iron Man.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wonder Man
metas.description: Small-time actor Simon Williams struggles to reckon with his personal life while hiding his super-powers as he tries to land his dream role. Meanwhile, a shady government agent leverages a new friendship in order to save his own job.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
metas.description: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Marvel Zombies
metas.description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking their lives to save their world.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
metas.description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
metas.description: Malcolm and his daughter are drawn into the family's chaos when Hal and Lois demand his presence for their 40th wedding anniversary party.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Dying for Sex
metas.description: Story of a woman diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer, who abandons her husband of 15 years and begins to fully explore her sexuality.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2025 · Eyes of Wakanda
metas.description: Wakandan warriors who, throughout history, have traveled the world to retrieve dangerous vibranium artifacts.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
metas.description: Follows the galaxy's criminal underworld. Asajj Ventress, a former assassin, flees with a new ally, while Cad Bane confronts his past when meeting an old friend turned Marshal.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Tempest
metas.description: Munju, an ex-ambassador, and Sanho, a secret agent, investigate an attack that could destabilize the Korean peninsula, unraveling a dangerous conspiracy that jeopardizes regional peace and security.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Good American Family
metas.description: A Midwestern couple who adopts what they believe is little girl with dwarfism. As they begin to raise her alongside their three biological children, falling into a battle fought in the tabloids, the courtroom and ultimately their ...

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2025 · Reminder
metas.description: Deniz, a reliable, famous architect, and Güneş, a phenomenal editor, who decided to separate six months ago while on their way to a wedding, are swept into a journey that will change their lives with a message that arrives on their phones on the evening of the day they met by chance. This new adventure will make them discover the missing pieces of their old relationship and remind them of love.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Win or Lose
metas.description: Follows a middle school softball team in the week leading up to their championship game, and each episode is told from the perspective of a different character.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · The Manipulated
metas.description: Mild-mannered Tae Jung is wrongfully imprisoned for a heinous crime. He soon discovers that a mysterious figure named Yo Han orchestrated his downfall. Fueled by vengeance, Tae Jung sets out to make Yo Han pay.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Nine Puzzles
metas.description: Jo I-na finds her uncle murdered beside a puzzle piece but can't explain her presence. Ten years later, as a criminal profiler, she investigates murders where victims are found with similar puzzle pieces.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
metas.description: Centers on Amanda Knox's harrowing journey after being wrongfully imprisoned for her roommate's murder, her battle to prove her innocence and regain her freedom.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2025 · Taylor Swift: The End of an Era
metas.description: Taylor Swift's concert film captures the magic of her record-breaking tour, featuring backstage moments and special performances with fellow artists, while sharing personal insights from her closest circle.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes
metas.description: Police pursue suspects in failed bombing attempts. Innocent Brazilian man is misidentified as a suspect and shot dead by police. Police are found guilty in his death. Police Commissioner resigns.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Hyper Knife
metas.description: Seok, an eager yet genius neurosurgeon is reunited with Deokhee, the professor who ruined her life long ago. Once, the two surgeons cared for each other more than anyone else. But now with nothing but hatred toward each other, Seok is furious that he is back in her life and vows to take revenge.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2025 · The Eighth Family
metas.description: With their invention of bulletproof thermal underwear, the Basmacıgil Family earns the title of the Eighth Family, one of the ruling forces of the world. Yet, as six very different siblings attempt to run the family business, their well-meaning but ineffective efforts leave their father Erol convinced that “no outside enemy is necessary."

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · We'll Be Fine
metas.description: Aktan and Lal, two polar opposites who meet at a party, find themselves caught up in a grand love story. Their fairytale romance spirals into chaos as they change everything in their lives to be together.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Made in Korea
metas.description: In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · The Murky Stream
metas.description: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · The Breslau Murders
metas.description: Commissioner Franz Podolsky investigates a brutal murder and, because of the upcoming Olympic Games, the pressure is on to catch the murderer.

metas.name: ★ 5.3 · 2025 · Twelve
metas.description: A group of heroes, each embodying one of the 12 zodiac signs, battles to defend the Korean Peninsula from malevolent spirits.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2026 · Lucky Luke
metas.description: Lucky Luke must help Louise find her mother, who mysteriously disappeared, while foiling a plot that could change the course of American history.
